note: win_rate = match points per game with a tie worth 1/3 of a win; baseline is the average over all non-mirror games, so above baseline is better than average. shrunk adds 20 games at baseline to each matchup. expected_vs_field weights matchups by the latest window's share of all players, expected_vs_day2 by its share of day 2. day2_record counts only rounds in which both players had made day 2.
